tldr_points: US PPI cooling eases hawkish Fed premium, undermining USD yield support.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: Price Below MA20 and ETF Outflows Signal Bearish Bias
tldr_points: BTC/USD at 65070.54 trades 13.3% below MA20 of 75043.83 with RSI-14 at 22.87, confirming bearish trend structure.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $1.0 billion in outflows for a second straight week, eroding fundamental demand.
Regulatory and security headwinds—including the Binance DOJ seizure and Kava exploit—further weigh on sentiment.
